heading: INT. FREIGHT ELEVATOR - SHUTTERED DEPARTMENT STORE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FREIGHT ELEVATOR - SHUTTERED DEPARTMENT STORE - NIGHT
The cage of an old service elevator, slatted with steel.
Bare bulbs bleed yellow across scaffolds of dust-sheeted mannequins.
Somewhere below, a generator coughs.
MALACHI (50s, a heavy man in a camel overcoat, rings on every finger) occupies the center of the car like a man who owns the floor.
SOLEDAD (30s, tailored suit, hair scraped back, eyes like flint) stands beside him with a briefcase.
BIG RAY (40s, bouncer's shoulders, scar through one eyebrow) holds the gate.
TWITCH (20s, skinny, jittery, earbuds dangling) fidgets with a lighter.
FIONNUALA (30s, rain-slicked trench, a plain gray folder) stands at the back, composed, the one person in the car who has not looked at anyone else.
The elevator creaks, sinks.
Each floor flickers by in the gaps of the gate: Housewares, Menswear, Toys, a ghostly Bridal with rows of veils like cobwebs.
Nobody speaks until the basement.
units.name: MALACHI

units.text: Twitch clicks the lighter.
Big Ray's hand tightens on the gate.
Soledad glances at the briefcase, then at Fionnuala, then at the ceiling.
Fionnuala adjusts her glasses and does not blink.
The elevator shudders to a halt between floors.
The bulb swings.
Malachi's ring clicks against the rail.
For a moment, the five of them stand motionless in the swaying light, and the generator's cough is the only sound in the building.
Then Twitch lunges for the briefcase.
Soledad slams him against the cage.
Big Ray yanks him off by the collar and pins him to the wall.
Malachi, unmoving, raises one finger.
Everything stops.
The lighter drops.
It rolls across the floor, spinning, until Fionnuala pins it under her heel.
She opens her folder.
Takes out a single photograph.
Holds it up for all of them.
Soledad's face drains.
Malachi lowers his finger.
The elevator starts to descend again.
